rows.text: Monetary Policy Committee's Decision on 28 February 2007
Bank of Thailand, announces that the Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) met today to assess
economy in 2007. However, inflationary pressures were expected to be on a downward trend and
core inflation should remain within the target range.
The MPC viewed that the risks to inflationary pressures were low and monetary policy could be eased in support of a further expansion of the economy.
